mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines, it indicates a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drag on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y declines in both HOUST and RSAFS, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and falling, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing above a 3% annualized rate and the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 55, it indicates a strong and broadening economic expansion that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growing > 3% y-o-y and INDPRO > 55, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it indicates an inflationary environment that will erode the purchasing power of fixed-income assets and drive investors into equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rising > 3% y-o-y and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances.
